verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Teach me Your ways, O Lord
And I will walk in Your truth
Show me Your paths, O Lord
For I am devoted to You

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Give me an undivided heart
That I may fear Your name
Give me an undivided heart
No other gods, no other loves
No other gods before You

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Purify my heart's desire
I long to be Your servant

verse.name: o1a
verse.lines:
You want all of our hearts
Not just one part
You want all of our hearts
Given over to You

verse.name: o1b
verse.lines:
We give all of our hearts
Not just one part
We give all of our hearts
